verdict.rationale: Loops documents the core campaign loop as a first-party feature. Campaigns 'send to a segment of contacts one time' (loops-docs-51), and the marketing page lists 'Create a campaign / Build an audience segment / Send a newsletter' (loops-docs-31). Composition is covered by a visual editor and the Content API, with drafts reviewed and sent from the dashboard (loops-docs-18, loops-docs-5), and audiences come from dynamic segments (loops-docs-16). missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduling a campaign for later, in-depth campaign-workflow docs beyond headline mentions, independent hands-on corroboration of campaign sending.
